name: Wanko no Yomeiri ~Youkoso! Inu no Shippo e~
original_name: わんこの嫁入り ～ようこそ！いぬのしっぽへ～
source:
Taiya is the only son of a shrine priest, and his dream is to become a pâtissier. Caught between his dreams and reality, his life completely changed with the arrival of twins Koharu and Azuki. They had dog ears and tails and introduced themselves as divine messengers who came to marry him as promised. Eager to change the dated image of the shrine, he decided to open a ‘shrine cafe’ and asked for their help in making it turn into reality.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/07/02/july-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
泰亚是神社祭司的独生子，他的梦想是成为一名糕点师。夹在梦想与现实之间的他的生活随着双胞胎小春和小豆的到来而彻底改变。他们长着狗耳朵和狗尾巴，自我介绍是神圣的使者，按照约定来嫁给他。为了改变神社过时的形象，他决定开设一家“神社咖啡馆”，并请求他们帮助将其变成现实。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/07/02/july-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~！[/url]]
